# Triage Fixture

## Originating Finding

A reviewer reports that a public source may be too stale for a support claim, but the
source has no version history and the claim owner has not identified the release scope in
which it will be used.

## Expected Triage

Classify the finding as `unresolved`, record the inspected evidence and missing release
scope in the governing pull request, and identify the exact repository-owner decision
needed. The triage reviewer must not be the originating reviewer, change author, or
implementation agent. Do not force a true-positive or false-positive result and do not
close the finding without recorded owner disposition and rationale.
